definitions.explanation: Describes a person or entity that lacks physical strength or the power to influence a situation. Can refer to physical weakness or to inability to make a difference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非力|ひりき}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
{非力|ひりき}な⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{重|おも}すぎる。
examples.english: This luggage is too heavy for weak me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{非力|ひりき}な⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{痛感|つうかん}→痛感：13614_tsuukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keenly felt that humans are powerless in the face of natural disasters.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used when reflecting on one's own limitations or inability to help. Can describe physical weakness or a more abstract sense of helplessness. Carries a humble or self-deprecating tone when used about oneself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非力|ひりき}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (though powerless, I will try)
- {非力|ひりき}な⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ (my powerless self)
- {非力|ひりき}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛感|つうかん}→痛感：13614_tsuukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to keenly feel one's powerlessness)
